review_note: The Group remained loss-making and cash-consuming, depended on a £2.34m net equity raise plus partner working-capital funding, and had not yet reached consistent profitability and cash generation. Revenue nevertheless rose 9%, gross margin expanded materially to 80.5%, the loss and operating cash burn both reduced, recurring subscription revenue grew and closing cash was £2.65m, supplying substantial contrary evidence.

The iTrack disposal and licensing transformation were already completed and are excluded as future target events; no material unresolved intervention pressure remained. Continuing revenue nearly tripled, gross margin rose to 78.3%, the continuing loss narrowed to £0.16m, operating cash tracked results, borrowings were eliminated and £1.05m cash was described as ample, supplying strong quantified contrary evidence.

No specific unresolved operating pressure was evident; £0.22m exceptional severance cost was contained. Revenue rose 34%, gross margin increased to 87%, adjusted profit before tax increased fourfold, net assets strengthened, cash was broadly stable after share buybacks and the Group had no external borrowing, supplying multiple exceptional quantified contrary indicators.
